function.name: impl_from_IMoniker
function.description: This function returns the containing record for the given interface, specifically the ItemMonikerImpl record.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is the interface from which the containing record is to be retrieved.

function.return_type: ItemMonikerImpl*, which represents the containing record for the given interface.

function.name: impl_from_IROTData
function.description: This function returns a pointer to an ItemMonikerImpl structure that contains the given IROTData interface pointer.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is an interface pointer that is used to find the containing ItemMonikerImpl structure.

function.return_type: ItemMonikerImpl* - a pointer to the ItemMonikerImpl structure that contains the given IROTData interface pointer.

function.name: impl_lock_from_IUnknown
function.description: This function returns a pointer to a container_lock structure that contains the given IUnknown interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IUnknown interface

function.return_type: struct container_lock pointer, representing a pointer to a container_lock structure that contains the given IUnknown interface

function.name: container_lock_QueryInterface
function.description: This function checks if the provided interface ID matches with IID_IUnknown. If it matches, it increases the reference count of the interface and returns S_OK. If it doesn't match, it warns about the unsupported interface and returns E_NOINTERFACE.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface that is being queried

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Identifier of the interface being requested

parameters.name: obj
parameters.description: Address of pointer variable that receives the interface pointer requested in riid

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. S_OK if the interface is supported, E_NOINTERFACE otherwise

function.name: container_lock_AddRef
function.description: This function increments the reference count of a container lock object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is used to get the container lock object.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the incremented reference count of the container lock object.

function.name: container_lock_Release
function.description: This function releases a lock on a container. It decrements the reference count of the lock. If the reference count reaches zero, it unlocks the container, releases the container, and frees the lock.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is used to get the container lock implementation.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the reference count after it has been decremented.

function.name: set_container_lock
function.description: This function sets a lock on a container. It first allocates memory for the lock. If the allocation fails, it returns an error. If the allocation is successful, it attempts to lock the container. If the lock fails, it frees the memory and returns an error. If the lock is successful, it sets the lock's properties, registers the lock, releases it, and returns the result.

parameters.name: container
parameters.description: This is the container that the function will attempt to lock.

parameters.name: pbc
parameters.description: This is the bind context used for registering the lock.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the result of the function. It can indicate success, failure due to memory allocation issues, or failure due to the container lock operation.

function.name: ItemMonikerImpl_QueryInterface
function.description: This function is used to query an interface of a COM object. If the requested interface is supported by the object, the function returns a pointer to that interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface of a COM object.

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface being requested.

parameters.name: ppvObject
parameters.description: Address of pointer variable that receives the interface pointer requested in riid. Upon successful return, *ppvObject contains the requested interface pointer. If the object does not support the interface, *ppvObject is set to NULL.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the call to the function. It returns S_OK if the interface is supported, E_NOINTERFACE if not supported, and E_INVALIDARG if ppvObject is NULL.

function.name: ItemMonikerImpl_AddRef
function.description: This function increments the reference count of the ItemMonikerImpl object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IMoniker interface object.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count after the increment.

function.name: ItemMonikerImpl_Release
function.description: This function releases an ItemMonikerImpl object, decrements its reference count, and frees its memory if the reference count reaches zero.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the IMoniker interface of the ItemMonikerImpl object to be released.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count of the ItemMonikerImpl object after it has been decremented.

function.name: ItemMonikerImpl_GetClassID
function.description: This function checks if the pointer to the Class ID is null, if not, it assigns the Class ID of the Item Moniker to the pointer and returns a success code.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to the Moniker

parameters.name: pClassID
parameters.description: Pointer to the Class ID

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns E_POINTER if pClassID is NULL, otherwise returns S_OK.

function.name: ItemMonikerImpl_IsDirty
function.description: This function checks if the OLE-provided moniker interfaces have changed their internal state. However, they always return S_FALSE because their internal state never changes.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is an interface pointer to the OLE-provided moniker interfaces.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. In this case, it always returns S_FALSE indicating that the internal state of the OLE-provided moniker interfaces never changes.

function.name: item_moniker_load_string_record
function.description: This function reads a string record from a stream, handles memory allocation and error checking, and returns the string in a wide character format.

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: The input stream from which the string record is read.

parameters.name: ret
parameters.description: A pointer to a wide character string where the result will be stored.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, E_FAIL if there is a failure in reading from the stream or if the string is not null terminated, and E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails.

function.name: ItemMonikerImpl_Load
function.description: This function loads a string record into the itemDelimiter and itemName fields of an ItemMonikerImpl object from a given stream.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IMoniker interface, used to get the implementation of ItemMonikerImpl.

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: Pointer to an IStream interface, from which the string records are loaded.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If it fails, it returns an error code.

function.name: ItemMonikerImpl_Save
function.description: This function saves the item moniker implementation. It writes the size and value of the item delimiter string and the item name string to the stream.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to the item moniker implementation

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: Stream where the data will be written

parameters.name: fClearDirty
parameters.description: Boolean flag indicating whether to clear the dirty flag after saving

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the operation was successful, it returns S_OK. Otherwise, it returns an error code.

function.name: ItemMonikerImpl_GetSizeMax
function.description: This function calculates the maximum size of an ItemMoniker object and stores it in the provided ULARGE_INTEGER structure.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IMoniker interface object from which the ItemMonikerImpl object is derived.

parameters.name: pcbSize
parameters.description: Pointer to a ULARGE_INTEGER structure that receives the size of the ItemMoniker object.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if successful, and E_POINTER if the pcbSize parameter is NULL.

function.name: get_bind_speed_from_bindctx
function.description: This function retrieves the bind speed from a bind context.

parameters.name: pbc
parameters.description: Pointer to the bind context from which the bind speed is to be retrieved.

function.return_type: DWORD representing the bind speed. It can be either BINDSPEED_INDEFINITE, BINDSPEED_IMMEDIATE or BINDSPEED_MODERATE depending on the tick count deadline.

function.name: ItemMonikerImpl_BindToObject
function.description: This function binds an object to a moniker, which is a component that provides a pointer to an object. It is used in the implementation of the IMoniker interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IMoniker interface

parameters.name: pbc
parameters.description: Pointer to the IBindCtx interface, which represents the bind context

parameters.name: pmkToLeft
parameters.description: Pointer to the IMoniker interface that represents the moniker to the left of the current moniker

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface that the client is to use to communicate with the object

parameters.name: ppvResult
parameters.description: Address of pointer variable that receives the interface pointer requested in riid

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the result of the function execution. It can be a success or an error code

function.name: ItemMonikerImpl_BindToStorage
function.description: This function binds an item moniker to a storage. It first checks if the pmkToLeft parameter is not null, then binds the pmkToLeft to an IOleItemContainer object. If the binding is successful, it sets a lock on the container and gets the object storage of the container.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IMoniker interface

parameters.name: pbc
parameters.description: Pointer to an IBindCtx interface

parameters.name: pmkToLeft
parameters.description: Pointer to an IMoniker interface on the left

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface

parameters.name: ppvResult
parameters.description: Pointer to the pointer of the result

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the function is successful, E_INVALIDARG if pmkToLeft is NULL, or other error codes if the function fails.

function.name: ItemMonikerImpl_Reduce
function.description: This function reduces the moniker to its simplest form for the specified bind context.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the Item Moniker interface.

parameters.name: pbc
parameters.description: Pointer to the bind context interface.

parameters.name: dwReduceHowFar
parameters.description: Specifies how far the moniker should be reduced.

parameters.name: ppmkToLeft
parameters.description: Address of pointer variable that receives the reduced moniker that was originally to the left of this moniker.

parameters.name: ppmkReduced
parameters.description: Address of pointer variable that receives the reduced form of the moniker.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the operation was successful, the return value is MK_S_REDUCED_TO_SELF. If the ppmkReduced parameter is NULL, the function returns E_POINTER.

function.name: ItemMonikerImpl_ComposeWith
function.description: This function composes a new moniker with the current moniker from the right. If the right moniker is an anti-moniker, it creates a new anti-moniker. If the 'only_if_not_generic' parameter is TRUE, it returns an error if the moniker is generic.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface of the current moniker

parameters.name: right
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface of the right moniker

parameters.name: only_if_not_generic
parameters.description: Flag indicating whether the function should return an error if the moniker is generic

parameters.name: result
parameters.description: Pointer to the pointer of the resulting moniker

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It can be a success code, an error code or a warning code.

function.name: ItemMonikerImpl_Enum
function.description: This function checks if the ppenumMoniker pointer is NULL, if it is, it returns an error, otherwise it sets the value pointed by ppenumMoniker to NULL and returns a success code.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer used in the function

parameters.name: fForward
parameters.description: Boolean value used in the function

parameters.name: ppenumMoniker
parameters.description: Double pointer to IEnumMoniker, checked and potentially modified in the function

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation, either success (S_OK) or an error (E_POINTER)

function.name: ItemMonikerImpl_IsEqual
function.description: This function compares two IMoniker objects for equality.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: First IMoniker object to compare

parameters.name: other
parameters.description: Second IMoniker object to compare

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if the objects are equal, S_FALSE if they are not, and E_INVALIDARG if the 'other' parameter is null.

function.name: ItemMonikerImpl_Hash
function.description: This function calculates a hash value for an ItemMonikerImpl object. It uses the object's itemName to calculate the hash. If the pdwHash parameter is NULL, it returns an error.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IMoniker interface which is used to get the ItemMonikerImpl object

parameters.name: pdwHash
parameters.description: Pointer to a DWORD to store the calculated hash value

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if successful, or an error value otherwise

function.name: ItemMonikerImpl_IsRunning
function.description: This function checks if a specific item moniker is running.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface to the item moniker.

parameters.name: pbc
parameters.description: Pointer to the bind context.

parameters.name: pmkToLeft
parameters.description: Pointer to the moniker to the left of the current moniker.

parameters.name: pmkNewlyRunning
parameters.description: Pointer to the newly running moniker.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation was successful, and an error code otherwise.

function.name: ItemMonikerImpl_GetTimeOfLastChange
function.description: This function gets the time of the last change of the object that the moniker refers to. If the object is not in the Running Object Table (ROT), the function calls IMoniker::GetTimeOfLastChange on the pmkToLeft parameter.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IMoniker interface

parameters.name: pbc
parameters.description: Pointer to the IBindCtx interface

parameters.name: pmkToLeft
parameters.description: Pointer to the IMoniker interface that represents the moniker to the left of this moniker

parameters.name: pItemTime
parameters.description: Pointer to a FILETIME structure that receives the time of the last change

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It can return E_INVALIDARG if pItemTime is NULL, MK_E_NOTBINDABLE if pmkToLeft is NULL, or the result of the CreateGenericComposite or IBindCtx_GetRunningObjectTable functions

function.name: ItemMonikerImpl_Inverse
function.description: This function checks if the ppmk parameter is NULL, if it is, it returns an error. If not, it calls the CreateAntiMoniker function with ppmk as the argument.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IMoniker interface

parameters.name: ppmk
parameters.description: Double pointer to an IMoniker interface

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the result of the function. It can be a success or an error code.

function.name: ItemMonikerImpl_CommonPrefixWith
function.description: This function checks if two IMoniker interfaces are equal. If they are, it sets the prefix to the interface and adds a reference to it. If they are not equal, it calls another function to find the common prefix.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: The first IMoniker interface to compare

parameters.name: other
parameters.description: The second IMoniker interface to compare

parameters.name: prefix
parameters.description: A pointer to an IMoniker interface that will be set to the common prefix if the two interfaces are equal

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the result of the operation. It returns MK_S_US if the interfaces are equal, otherwise it returns the result of the MonikerCommonPrefixWith function

function.name: ItemMonikerImpl_RelativePathTo
function.description: This function checks the validity of the parameters and returns a specific HRESULT value.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IMoniker interface.

parameters.name: other
parameters.description: Pointer to another IMoniker interface.

parameters.name: result
parameters.description: Double pointer to an IMoniker interface, used to store the result.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the function execution. It returns E_INVALIDARG if either 'other' or 'result' is NULL, and MK_E_NOTBINDABLE otherwise.

function.name: ItemMonikerImpl_GetDisplayName
function.description: This function retrieves the display name of an item moniker. It checks if the display name and left moniker are valid, calculates the size of the item name and delimiter, allocates memory for the display name, and concatenates the item delimiter and name to the display name.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface of the item moniker

parameters.name: pbc
parameters.description: Pointer to the bind context

parameters.name: pmkToLeft
parameters.description: Pointer to the moniker to the left of the item moniker

parameters.name: ppszDisplayName
parameters.description: Pointer to the display name of the item moniker

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It can return S_OK if successful, E_POINTER if the display name is NULL, E_INVALIDARG if the left moniker is not NULL, or E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation for the display name fails

function.name: ItemMonikerImpl_ParseDisplayName
function.description: This function parses the display name of an item moniker. It binds the moniker to an object, locks the container, gets the object and parses the display name.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IMoniker interface

parameters.name: pbc
parameters.description: Pointer to the IBindCtx interface

parameters.name: pmkToLeft
parameters.description: Pointer to the IMoniker interface that represents the moniker to the left of the current moniker

parameters.name: displayname
parameters.description: Pointer to the display name to be parsed

parameters.name: eaten
parameters.description: Pointer to the number of characters parsed from the display name

parameters.name: ppmkOut
parameters.description: Pointer to the output IMoniker interface

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the operation was successful, it returns S_OK. Otherwise, it returns an error code.

function.name: ItemMonikerImpl_IsSystemMoniker
function.description: This function checks if the system moniker is valid and sets the value of pwdMksys to MKSYS_ITEMMONIKER if it is valid.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is an interface pointer used in the function.

parameters.name: pwdMksys
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a DWORD in which the function stores the value of MKSYS_ITEMMONIKER if the system moniker is valid.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, and E_POINTER if pwdMksys is NULL.

function.name: ItemMonikerROTDataImpl_QueryInterface
function.description: This function is used to query an interface from an ItemMonikerImpl object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IROTData interface.

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface being requested.

parameters.name: ppvObject
parameters.description: Address of pointer variable that receives the interface pointer requested in riid.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the operation was successful, the return value is S_OK.

function.name: ItemMonikerROTDataImpl_AddRef
function.description: This function adds a reference to an ItemMonikerImpl object from an IROTData interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to an IROTData interface.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count of the ItemMonikerImpl object.

function.name: ItemMonikerROTDataImpl_Release
function.description: This function releases the ItemMonikerImpl instance from the IROTData interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is the interface from which the ItemMonikerImpl instance is to be released.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the status of the ItemMonikerImpl release operation.

function.name: ItemMonikerROTDataImpl_GetComparisonData
function.description: This function gets the comparison data for an ItemMoniker object. It calculates the length of the item's name and delimiter, determines the total data length, checks if the buffer has enough space, and then writes the CLSID, delimiter, and name to the buffer.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to the ItemMoniker object

parameters.name: buffer
parameters.description: Buffer to write the comparison data to

parameters.name: max_len
parameters.description: Maximum length of the buffer

parameters.name: data_len
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable where the function will store the actual length of the written data

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if successful, E_OUTOFMEMORY if the buffer does not have enough space

function.name: unsafe_impl_from_IMoniker
function.description: This function checks if the virtual function table of the interface is the same as the VT_ItemMonikerImpl. If it is, it returns the containing record of the interface, otherwise it returns NULL.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is used to access the interface's virtual function table and to get the containing record.

function.return_type: ItemMonikerImpl pointer. It represents the containing record of the interface if the virtual function table of the interface is the same as the VT_ItemMonikerImpl, otherwise it represents NULL.

function.name: CreateItemMoniker
function.description: This function creates an Item Moniker by allocating memory for it, setting its properties, and returning a pointer to it.

parameters.name: delimiter
parameters.description: The delimiter for the Item Moniker.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the Item Moniker.

parameters.name: ret
parameters.description: A pointer to a pointer to an IMoniker interface, which will be set to point to the newly created Item Moniker.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, and E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails.

function.name: ItemMoniker_CreateInstance
function.description: This function creates an instance of an ItemMoniker, which is a type of COM object that provides a link to an object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IClassFactory interface that creates the object

parameters.name: outer
parameters.description: Pointer to the controlling IUnknown interface, if part of an aggregate component

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface that the caller is to use to communicate with the new object

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: Address of pointer variable that receives the interface pointer requested in riid

function.return_type: HRESULT, which indicates the success or failure of the function. It returns specific error codes when the function fails.
